sources.title: Quantitative properties of the non-properness set of a polynomial map
sources.role: Explicit proof input: Definition 2.1, Proposition 2.2, Definition 2.3, and Theorem 3.2. For a generically finite polynomial map from complex affine space, its nonproperness set is covered by nonconstant polynomial images of A1. Only this qualitative conclusion is used, not the degree bound.
